findings.passage: If all Georgians, regardless of party, fight against Trump’s attempts to require documentary proof of citizenship in order to vote, we will help to preserve the right of every American citizen to vote.
findings.note: Closing line of an AJC guest column she co-wrote with two other authors (page shows updated 2026-02-07). The column is about the federal SAVE Act and documentary proof of citizenship.
subjects: documentary proof of citizenship to register or vote

findings.passage: The nonpartisan League of Women Voters estimates that 69 million American women lack a birth certificate that reflects their current name, because they have married and have done what most have always done, changed their last name to match their husbands’ names.
findings.note: Same co-written AJC column; gives a reason documentary proof of citizenship would be hard to meet.
subjects: documentary proof of citizenship to register or vote

findings.passage: Obtaining a photocopy can be challenging for many Georgians, and this additional step will mean disenfranchisement for many voters with mobility issues, transportation issues, in poverty or who are sheltering in place.
findings.note: Quoted by the AJC before she held office, speaking for a voting-rights role at the time, on the photocopy of ID needed for an absentee ballot application under SB 202.
subjects: ID with mail or absentee ballot

findings.note: Quoted by Capitol Beat on the 2024 end-of-session elections bill that included changes to voter eligibility challenges. This is about voter-roll challenges, not ID.
